title: Scholarly Commentary, Intertextuality & Linked Open Annotation
query: How do TEI analytic mechanisms and the W3C Web Annotation / Open Annotation data model structure scholarly commentary and intertextual linking in digital editions, and what are the capabilities and hazards of AI-assisted commentary?

results.title: Annotations as semantic traces: a multi-level ontology for digital hermeneutics
results.authors_venue_year: Annotations as semantic traces: a multi-level ontology for digital hermeneuticsCT Pedretti - 2026 - tesidottorato.depositolegale.itDefines a conceptual model for scholarly annotations using Semantic Web technologies, built upon existing standards for cultural heritage and humanities domains, to address the semantic deficits in most digital annotation systems.WADM Structure and Interoperability: Details how the W3C Web Annotation Data Model (WADM) provides a structured, web-friendly approach by defining an Annotation as an association between a Target and a Body, typically expressed in JSON-LD, making it the standard for open, interoperable annotation on the web.AI-Assisted Commentary Validation: Validates the proposed model on the Charles Sanders Peirce personal manuscripts archive to demonstrate its capability to handle annotations generated by AI through scholarly editorial validation and interpretive refinement.Save Cite Related articles All 3 versions  View as HTML [PDF] springer.com

results.authors_venue_year: A web application for exploring primary sources: The DanteSources case studyV Bartalesi, C Meghini, D Metilli… - … Scholarship in the …, 2018 - academic.oup.comExplains the adoption of the Open Annotation Model (now a W3C standard) to represent a commentary (Annotation class) with properties linking the comment (TextualBody) to its target resource (the primary source).TEI Format Use: Mentions that DaMA is a digital archive containing Dante's works and primary sources in XML-TEI format, allowing visualization of the source text but not providing explicit links between fragments of Dante's work and the corresponding primary sources.Hazards of Interpretation: Discusses potential issues with formal knowledge representation, such as handling conflicting interpretations in commentaries and resulting inconsistencies in the ontology, which they address by considering the addition of information about who interpreted the commentary.Save Cite Cited by 19 Related articles All 8 versions  [PDF] arxiv.org

results.title: AnchoredAI: Contextual Anchoring of AI Comments Improves Writer Agency and Ownership
results.authors_venue_year: AnchoredAI: Contextual Anchoring of AI Comments Improves Writer Agency and OwnershipM Lou, J Crowley, S Dodson, D Yoon - arXiv preprint arXiv:2509.16128, 2025 - arxiv.orgIntroduces AnchoredAI, a system that combines the precision of anchored comments with the generative capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) by attaching suggestions directly to their referent spans in the text.Mitigating AI Hazards: Explains that anchoring AI comments directly to text spans can mitigate overreliance and enable more precise, user-driven revision practices, thus addressing the potential hazards of AI-assisted commentary.Mechanisms for Context: Details the technical mechanisms used by AnchoredAI for structuring commentary, including an Anchoring Context Window (ACW) that maintains unique references and an update-aware context retrieval method that preserves comment intent after document edits.Save Cite Related articles All 2 versions  View as HTML
